title: [review] tx_queue.py:400: pop() does not signal reservat
description: When pop() is called on an entry that was pushed with return_reservation=True, the reservation is never signaled (set_result is never called). Callers awaiting reservation.wait() will hang indefinitely. The method does self._entries.pop(0).data directly without signaling the entry's reservation. Compare to _remove_first() and complete() which properly signal reservations.
close_reason: Fixed: pop() now signals reservation.set_result(True) before returning data. Added regression test test_pop_signals_reservation_true.
